name: How long does it take to complete a bathroom addition?
description: Construction generally takes 4 to 8 weeks for interior conversions and 8 to 12 weeks for exterior bump-outs, following permit approvals and design sign-offs.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete bathroom addition typically takes between 4 to 12 weeks of active construction after permits are issued. Interior conversions generally move faster, often wrapping up in 4 to 8 weeks because the foundation, exterior framing, and roof are already intact. Exterior bump-out additions take longer, often 8 to 12 weeks, as they require foundation pouring, exterior framing, roofing, stucco or siding, and full interior drywall and tile work. Weather, permit processing intervals, and custom fixture lead times also influence the timeline.
